meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **budget** mein shaadi ke liye online saree lene ke liye aapko *silk-look, organza, georgette, chiffon, aur Banarasi-style* options dekhni chahiye, kyunki inmein wedding feel aati hai aur price comparatively manageable hota hai.[11][17][18]

**Achhe budget options aur unke price signals:**
- **Meesho** par wedding sarees **₹149 se start** ho rahi hain, aur kaafi options **₹299 se kam** mein mil rahe hain.[1]
- **Manyavar/Mohey** par sarees ki range **₹1,499** se start hoti hai; budget-friendly options mein **Rani Pink Saree ₹1,499**, **Fluttering Light Blue Saree ₹2,999**, aur **Elegant Pink Chiffon Saree ₹2,999** listed hain.[11]
- **Amrut Fashion** par wedding saree sale price **₹2,499** tak dikh raha hai.[12]
- **TradeIndia** listings mein wedding sarees ka range roughly **₹1,200–₹7,430** aur kuch items **₹2,000–₹3,599** ke aas-paas listed hain.[18]

**Shaadi ke liye budget mein kaunsi saree type best rahegi:**
- **Banarasi/Banarasi-style**: wedding look strong hota hai, budget mein synthetic blend versions mil jaate hain.[11][17]
- **Kanjivaram/Kanchipuram-inspired**: agar premium look chahiye, lekin real silk costly ho sakti hai; budget versions dekhna better hai.[5][6][8]
- **Organza with embroidery**: light, stylish, aur comparatively affordable options milte hain.[11]
- **Georgette/chiffon with work**: guest function ya reception ke liye budget-friendly aur easy to drape hote hain.[11]
- **Leheriya/printed festive sarees**: budget mein color-rich wedding vibe deti hain.[4]

**Practical recommendation:**
- Agar aapka budget **₹1,000–₹3,000** hai, to **Meesho, Manyavar/Mohey, aur Amrut** pe dekhiye.[1][11][12]
- Agar budget **₹3,000–₹8,000** hai, to **TradeIndia-style marketplaces** aur mid-range festive collections better rahengi.[18]
- Agar aap **bride** hain aur zyada rich look chahiye, to **Kanchipuram/Kanjivaram, Banarasi, ya embroidered silk-style** saree lo; agar aap **guest** hain, to **organza, chiffon, georgette** zyada sensible rahegi.[1][5][8][11]

Agar aap chahein, main aapke **exact budget** ke hisaab se 5 best saree options shortlist kar doon — jaise **₹2,000 ke andar**, **₹5,000 ke andar**, ya **bride vs guest** ke liye alag-alag.
